page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates for multi-node clusters and external service communication.

Given the high core count and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance provides resource density suitable for large-scale parallel processing without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is designed for workloads such as distributed databases, enterprise application hosting, containerized microservices, and general-purpose high-throughput computing tasks where dedicated CPU allocation is required.
